title: Qatar conflict z>1 leads LNG 1d
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Robustness: Qatar GDELT conflict event count 20d z-score > 1 leads Cheniere (LNG) returns by 1 day (+); trade long LNG 4d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.LNG.log_return] (parent: R2-0023)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.qat.conflict_events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long LNG next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Null control: Qatar GDELT conflict event count 20d z-score > 1 leads SPY returns by 1 day (+); if this also "works", the LNG effect is a broad-market/war common shock, not a gas-specific signal; trade long SPY 1d [gdelt.qat.conflict_events -> finance.SPY.log_return] (parent: R2-0122)
